candidates.statement: In response to the conflict escalation in October 2023, Australian Red Cross provided support to people in Australia and on the ground in Israel and the Occupied Palestinian Territories; supported repatriation to New South Wales and Western Australia; provided cash assistance to people from Israel and the Occupied Palestinian Territories on temporary visas experiencing financial hardship; mobilised over $4 million for ICRC and IFRC work in Israel, the Occupied Palestinian Territories, Egypt, and Lebanon; deployed 12 delegates; and helped establish and staff a 60-bed ICRC field hospital in Rafah, Gaza.

candidates.statement: The Australian Red Cross Society has a comprehensive risk governance and accountability framework guided by a three-lines-of-engagement model. The Board oversees risk, sets risk appetite and strategic risk tolerance thresholds, the Audit & Risk Committee focuses on risk and assurance, management owns and operationalises risk controls, and independent assurance is provided through the third line. The framework also emphasises accountability, timely escalation, consideration of stakeholder and community impacts, organisational sustainability, and organisational learning.
